content.thinking:
The longest-reigning British monarch is Queen Victoria (reigned 1837-1901, 63 years and 7 months), though this was surpassed by Queen Elizabeth II (reigned 1952-2022, 70 years and 214 days).

So the longest-reigning British monarch is Queen Elizabeth II.

Her predecessor was King George VI.

Let me verify this with a quick web search to be sure.
